text:
marisa: Heads-up team 11 We need final landing copy for three product pages (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private) for the web deployment tomorrow morning. Focus: concise hero, one-line value prop, primary CTA text, and simple inbound routing rules. Also include a short benchmark blurb and a webinar CTA. Post options here.

tariq: Draft heroes: Hosted: 'Instant hosted inference for developers.' Dedicated: 'Committed GPU pools for predictable throughput.' Private: 'Private inference behind your network controls.'

eden: Slight tone tweak to be customer-facing: Hosted -> 'Hosted API: ship features fast with instant scale.' Dedicated -> 'Dedicated capacity: predictable performance and isolation.' Private -> 'Private deployment: keep data on your network, meet compliance.'

jess: Routing rules we need implemented in the lead form: enterprise leads -> sales; trial/credit signups -> growth; webinar registrants -> marketing. Example JSON for eng:

```
{
  "source": "webform",
  "params": {
    "enterprise": true,
    "path": "/pricing/enterprise"
  },
  "route": "sales"
}
```

devops-bot: Reminder: backend expects route keys: sales, growth, marketing-webinars.

marisa: Nice. One-line value props (10-12 words each) that surface the buyer tradeoffs: speed for Hosted, SLAs & isolation for Dedicated, control & compliance for Private.

tariq: Hosted: 'Fast onboarding and pay-as-you-go scale for rapid feature launches.'

eden: Dedicated: 'Reserved GPUs with SLA-backed performance, autoscaling, and burst capacity.'

jess: Private: 'Customer-hosted option with VPC, KMS, and on-premise deployment choices.'

marisa: Good. Benchmark blurb (20-30 words) that we can A/B test on the page emphasizing latency and cost efficiency.

tariq: 'On Dedicated, median generation latency measured under 70ms for benchmark prompts; batching + KV cache reduced per-token cost up to 3.5x versus naive single-call setups.'

eden: Shorten to: 'Median gen latency <70ms on Dedicated; batching and KV cache can cut per-token cost ~3x versus single-call baselines.'

marisa: Webinar CTA variations (6-10 words). Keep them punchy.

copybot: Variant 1: 'Live demo: reduce latency and inference costs.' Variant 2: 'Webinar: scale LLMs reliably and affordably.' Variant 3: 'See Redwood inference in action 1 live.'

jess: CTA placement: Primary = 'Get started 1 free credits' on Hosted. Primary on Dedicated could be 'Request Dedicated trial'. Secondary = 'Contact sales' for Private and Enterprise Dedicated.

eden: Add a subtle compliance banner for Private page: 'Need VPC or on-prem? Contact sales to discuss isolation and compliance options.' linked to contact form.

marisa: Action items:
- tariq: finalize three hero lines + three one-line value props by 10:30am
- eden: pick primary/secondary CTA texts and compliance banner copy by 11:00am
- jess: final routing JSON and form flag examples to eng by 11:15am
- copybot: produce 3 CTA A/B variants and 3 webinar CTA variants

jess: I'll open a content PR and tag /dev-handoff once assets are in the doc. devops-bot will validate routing keys.

devops-bot: When you push the PR include a sample curl that hits the form webhook and shows the route mapping.

marisa: Thanks all 1 if nobody objects I'll merge the copy into the content repo at 13:00 and ping eng for the handoff. Keep phrasing simple and customer-focused.
